title: SPECIMEN RACK
claim: Sibling host where tiny laws load as pure reducers — (state, t, ctx) → state' — and compose (CHAIN). Ships 3 built-in specimens (RIPPLE, RULE TAPE ECA-90, TIXY FIELD) plus LOAD LAW: any tixy/dwitter-style formula entered by the operator runs locally as a live specimen. A ganja.js (PGA2D) algebra specimen renders in-page. Frozen five untouched; no forced shared runtime.
why_this_is_a_sibling_and_not_a_donor_ch: The five LAW ZOO machines are FROZEN_DONOR — their identity is exact bytes. This page reads none of them; it hosts its own loadable specimens and links out by concept only. Carries the zoo's 'shared principle, no forced shared runtime' law: composition happens at the reducer/loader layer, never by merging donors. Directly answers the THREAD_SEAL open question 'can local laws migrate between machines' — yes, as loadable reducers.
